T_units: monthly managed-payoff observations used for estimation
C0_selection: once, minimum mean (1 - raw portfolio excess payoff)^2 on 1973-1977 formation validation, fitted on 1963-1972
grid: retain all original 120 initial-spectrum lambdas and add 80 midpoints in initial effective complexity, evenly distributed across gaps; convert to C0 with initial-training b and T=120

b_estimation.method: OLS log positive managed second-moment eigenvalue on log rank
b_estimation.domain: unconstrained; stop if estimated b <= 1, rather than silently clip

annual_refit: at January close, all formation history through prior December; last payoff is known at that close
performance: 12 next-month payoffs per formation year; February through following January
loss: mean squared (1 - raw unscaled portfolio excess payoff); no ridge term in OOS loss
heatmap: linear interpolation in log complexity within each year only; no extrapolation, smoothing, or imputed performance
shape: empirical only; no U-shape or monotonic selected complexity imposed
b_note: finite-sample spectral slope is a plug-in diagnostic, not proof of the population polynomial-tail assumption
lambda_note: annual changes in b can cause local increases in lambda despite the fixed-b asymptotic decay rate
reference_paper: economomic_spectrum_final.tex, theorem Optimal shrinkage and learnable frontier; r=1 specialization in main text
source_caveats: Inherited complete-case payoff availability filter, retrospective signal dictionary and current JKP snapshot; same-close execution assumption.
